journal_lines: Red dust in the deepslate. Redstone.
Deep vein, crackling faintly. Took the lot.
Redstone runs in veins down here. Found a good one.
The deep rock glows red when you chip it.
Red glow steady in the wall, like a thing remembering its own heartbeat.
The dust hummed in the bag. Quiet, but it hummed.
Crackled when I struck it. Crackled less, eventually.
Red dust on the fur. Looked like I had been somewhere and won, modestly.
Worked the seam slowly. The stone did not like to give it up.
A vein you can almost hear thinking. Almost.
Found a chunk the size of a fist, still warm. Wrapped it in cloth.
Light went where the dust went. The bag glowed faintly all the way home.
